business_summary.text: Piramal Pharma is a diversified global pharma company with a CDMO business (Piramal Pharma Solutions), complex hospital generics (Piramal Critical Care) and consumer healthcare (Piramal Consumer Healthcare), operating across 100+ countries.

call_points.text: All three businesses are expected to deliver growth in FY27, with accelerated EBITDA and PAT growth; no numeric targets given.
CDMO RFP and order inflows improved from October 2025, helped by US biopharma funding up 75% YoY in H2FY26.
US$94Mn invested in FY26 across growth and maintenance projects.
Kenalog® acquired for US$35Mn upfront plus up to US$65Mn contingent; margins in line with CHG.
Sevoflurane US market share rose to 47% from 45% in Mar'24; ex-US growth muted by competition, to accelerate in FY27.
Injectable pain management supply constraints persist; company is working with its supplier to resolve them.
Quality track record maintained: 38 regulatory inspections including 3 USFDA cleared in FY26, zero OAI status.
Q4 included a ₹176 Cr impairment of intangible assets under development, written down in full.

penalties.details: Product dimension details were inadvertently omitted in a listing created on the quick-commerce platform Blinkit. The issue was subsequently regularised and the compounding was completed on 3rd September, 2025
penalties.impact: There is no impact on financial, operation or other activities of the Company, other than penalty amount of Rs. 50,000/-

penalties.details: A compounding action was completed on 25th August, 2025, due to a contravention involving the Flipkart listing of Supradyn, where the manufacturer’s address was not specified.
penalties.impact: There is no impact on financial, operation or other activities of the Company, other than penalty amount, other than the penalty amount of Rs. 50,000/-

guidance.statement: All three businesses well positioned to deliver growth in FY27, with accelerated growth in EBITDA and PAT
US$90Mn capex to scale sterile injectable and payload-linker capacities at Lexington and Riverview on track

operating_notes.text: CDMO had 155+ molecules under development with 25 in Phase III in FY26, and 47% of revenue from innovation-related work.
US sevoflurane market share was 47% (IQVIA), up from 45% in Mar'24; CHG derives 73% of revenue from US, Europe and Japan.
PCH Power Brands grew 24% in FY26 and contributed 52% of PCH sales; e-commerce grew 48% and contributed about 27%.
